name: Marshal Kestrel
title: Marshal of the Waykeepers
examine: The road made flesh: weathered, direct, and carrying the whole map of the High Road behind her eyes.
lines: Every lamp between here and the ford answers to this room. Sit down if you've news; stand if you've complaints.
My grandmother built the first waystation out of her own crew's wages and a temper. The order keeps both traditions.
Edda taught me the lamp drill when I was nine. She'll outlast the mountain out of pure disapproval of the alternative.
